title: Fact-ori: Build a source-bound C007a Everest library candidate from reviewed prose
description:
FO-W015-A1. Prepare one frozen structured C007a candidate from Tinker author draft eebbf57c-9e3f-4149-95f9-806eaf781963 r3, exact UTF-8 body SHA256 0f62891b7c23eadcf9792cafb2db2228dcce8c495768955f263371d4425011ab. Preserve prose v2/r3 and original author @don.tinker / Don. Name the adapter, owner, recorder and contribution separately. Use a new explicitly identified candidate artifact version without silently replacing the prose version.

Pinned inputs at https://github.com/universal-market/fact-ori/tree/43c59043ed0b02ea2ee7e95ce73d991b0852da69 include data/FO-W015-C007a-v2-r3-review-input.json (raw e81cbdb01312667aaa757909bbe390576edfcffb9aacbf9efc9c336af18110e5), original review data/FO-W015-C007a-v2-r3-factfinder-review-v1.json (raw 8bded9cc3ec0cd5268a7f7a0202c3ec4ce3053c205fd11fe2a4b42669de5fefa), and supplement data/FO-W015-F1-factfinder-supplement-v1.json at commit d7afb4847774405554ce4d0c9b834174ec9292d2 (raw 3429b0b03f08fa85d90a78e5ad1d3ec00bc1112a00feef6f4cbe6dc045ac20d8). Reconcile current corrections before work.

Use current README, scripts/validate_pilot.py and C012-library-candidate-v1 as structural references. Deliver record/bundle/revision fixtures, file hashes, pending projection and a concise transformation map. Preserve Everest ranking above global mean sea level, dated 2020-12-08 joint 8848.86 m snow-surface announcement and reported orthometric/IHRS method as individually source-bound predicates. NOAA supports ranking only. Official announcement supports snow label. Nepal paper ff66ceb0 supports reported method/datum/figure, with historical snow/rock passages separated. CASM relay coverage is pinned supplied capture0b990e28, not verified original MNR or current live content.

Disclose common campaign dependence and reviewer Factfinder/package provider Factomaton shared Adrian ownership versus original author Don. Preserve unresolved publication metadata, access failures, unchecked originals and uncertainty limits. Distinguish original full-claim abstention from later limited technical acceptance. Do not populate exact-candidate reviews from older prose/source decisions. Keep review_status awaiting_review and reviews empty. Check consistency, pending answer withheld, and rejection of approval without exact reviews. Preserve old artifacts. Candidate remains outside active manifest/events/catalog/API.

This is candidate authoring only. Subsequent review must differ from both original author and adapter and cover combined predicates and transformation. No routing adoption, curation approval, API/job publication, deployment, paid services, credentials, new permissions or destructive actions are included. Check duplicate assignments before assent. Zero payment under work-free@1.0.0. Submit public immutable artifact URL/commit, raw and canonical digests and limits within the4096-byte Task deliverable. Recipient separately assesses submission.
